# Uttar Fitness

> Uttar Fitness is an AI-powered fitness tracker for workouts, weekly training plans, nutrition, health metrics, and progress.

Uttar Fitness is a web app for planning and tracking strength, cardio, mobility, and nutrition. The app is built with React and Firebase and is available at [xfit-bpe.pages.dev](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/).

## Main pages

- [Uttar Fitness home](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/)
- [Try the live demo](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/demo)
- [Workouts and run tracking](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/workouts)
- [Weekly training plan](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/plan)
- [Health, weight, and nutrition](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/health)
- [Community workouts](https://xfit-bpe.pages.dev/community)

## Notes for agents

- Signed-out visitors see a public landing page at `/` with an interactive demo at `/demo`. No account is needed to evaluate the product.
- In-app pages require a signed-in Firebase account. Signed-in visitors who open `/` are redirected to their dashboard at `/home`.
- The site is a single-page React app. Static metadata lives at `/llms.txt`, `/robots.txt`, and `/.well-known/ard.json`.
